Distribution Management Shouldn't Be Complicated

Distribution companies that are growing struggle due to their operations being spread across spreadsheets as well as manually-generated records, disconnected programs, and many systems. Vellko Distribution ERP solutions consolidate inventory, buying, warehouse management, logistics, sales, and finance on one platform, giving each department access to precise and real-time business information.

How Vellko Distribution ERP Works

Step 1: Schedule a Free Distribution ERP Demo

See how Vellko ERP can automate and track your entire supply chain and logistics in a live demonstration.

Step 2: Understand Your Distribution Processes

We analyze your order routing, warehouse layouts, supplier networks, and shipping schedules.

Step 3: Configure Workflows & Import Business Data

We import your client and supplier profiles, configure automated reorder levels, and set up invoice flows.

Step 4: Train Your Team & Go Live

Your logistics, inventory, purchasing, and sales managers receive detailed training for a smooth rollout.
